integrity: The result optimizes an acknowledged published interval and proves the exact algebraic feasibility region. Numerical checks are supplementary; originality may have historical-priority uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: The sharp threshold is for nonemptiness of one explicit sufficient correction interval under positive wave speed bounds and a monotone local increment; it is not a solver-wide CFL stability or TVD necessity theorem.
title: Sharp speed-contrast CFL frontier for a nonlinear Active Flux TVD correction interval
